isolatedReproductions.hostEvidence: Claude main.log: 'Using UtilityProcess for extension Navish Commander: appConfig.isUsingBuiltInNodeForMcp is true'; the extension server process is 'Claude Helper (Plugin) --type=utility --utility-sub-type=node.mojom.NodeService'; runtime/app/src/process.mjs (rc.4) spawned pipe supervisors and search.mjs spawned the search runner with process.execPath
isolatedReproductions.conclusion: The runtime code was correct under a plain Node binary; the failures were specific to the Electron host (execPath is not a Node executable; module loading is roughly 80x slower per file).
